name: Ueno Mariko
source: Mariko is the stubborn, nosy iincho type character that doesn’t allow any corners to be cut. Possessing a strong sense of justice, she often gets herself into messes outside of her jurisdiction. Perhaps the most naïve of the group, she even tried to boycott the game at the beginning.
